title: How a shift's pay adds up

lines.slot: Hook: one concrete case and the question the viewer has. Then the rules, once.
lines.text: [confident, full voice] Sam, a barista at Acme Café, worked one shift. How much did Sam earn? With these rules, here is how it adds up.

lines.slot: First step: the starting amount, then what comes off first. Numbers as words, so captions match the voice.
lines.text: [explaining] Sales came to *four hundred forty dollars*, tax included. Tax comes off first: that leaves *four hundred*.

lines.slot: The rule applied, and its result.
lines.text: [explaining] Sam keeps *thirty percent* of that: *one hundred twenty*.

lines.slot: A second source of money, with its own rule.
lines.text: [explaining] Tips were *fifty dollars*, and Sam keeps *ninety percent*: *forty-five*.

lines.slot: What is taken off, and what it is NOT applied to (the detail people get wrong).
lines.text: [clear, full voice] Withholding takes *ten percent* of the share, not of the tips: minus *twelve*.
[clear, full voice] So for this shift, Sam earned *one hundred fifty-three dollars*.

lines.slot: Proof: the same numbers on the real screen of the app, named in the order they appear.
lines.text: [explaining] And the app shows the same numbers: the share, the tips, the withholding and the total.

lines.slot: Brand close: your name and your one short line, spoken over the end card.
lines.text: [upbeat, not over the top] *Your Brand*. One short line.
